# Create Index Job File.vi

![Create Index Job File.vi function icon](../../../../assets/function-icons/functions/connectivity/DF-13.svg)

[Connectivity functions](../index.md) · [All functions](../../index.md)

Creates a job file for indexing certain files or folders from the search areas of a DataFinder server.
